description: This Java class defines a log filter component that passes through only message content, ignoring metadata like tags and priorities. It implements the LogNode interface and supports chaining with other LogNodes.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter that outputs only the message part of log entries, discarding other metadata. Designed for simplifying on-screen logs or quick message displays.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a LogNode to chain logs to. Initializes the filter with the next node in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Implements the LogNode interface. Forwards the message to the next node, with only the message content, ignoring metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode for chaining log outputs.
